claims.report_quote: Context formatting—such as delimiters and structural markers—significantly impacts RAG accuracy and stability, even with identical semantic content, highlighting the importance of context normalization.
claims.claim: Context formatting with delimiters and structural markers significantly improves RAG accuracy and stability, even when the semantic content is unchanged.
claims.label: SUPPORTED
claims.quote: seemingly superficial choices, such as delimiters or structural markers in key-value extraction, can induce substantial shifts in accuracy and stability, even when semantic content is identical.

claims.report_quote: Hybrid retrieval strategies (e.g., BM25 + dense) achieve superior retrieval precision compared to pure keyword or dense methods, though they still fall short of the ideal 'Oracle Context'.
claims.claim: Hybrid retrieval combining BM25 and dense methods yields higher retrieval precision than using either keyword or dense retrieval alone, yet still does not reach the performance of an ideal Oracle Context.
claims.label: SUPPORTED
claims.quote: RAG still underperforms compared to the Oracle Context, while Hybrid BM25 consistently achieves the best results across all four datasets.

claims.report_quote: Performance trade-offs exist: high-accuracy models exhibit elevated latency and operational cost, making them unsuitable for real-time or edge applications without optimization.
claims.claim: Models that achieve high accuracy incur higher latency and operational costs, rendering them unsuitable for real‑time or edge deployments without optimization.
